name: @clay-design-system/mcp

tools.name: clay_search
tools.description: Ask the Clay design system a question; returns the top record ids with summaries (BM25 + facets). Follow up with clay_get. Use `each` to resolve several names (logos, icons, sections) in one call.

query.description: Words to search for. Required unless `each` is given.

each.description: Several names to resolve in one call (logos, icons): the best hit per term; `query`, if set, is added to each.

k.description: How many hits (default 10; with `each`: per term, default 1).

kind.description: Record kinds or subkinds, e.g. gotcha, policy, layout, limit, rule, section, token, logo, icon.

stage.description: Only records that apply to these stages.

mode.description: web-compose mode: A = page brief, B = PMM brief (structure and copy already decided).

scope.description: Default web + ds + shared; email knowledge needs ["email"] (or ["all"]).

detail.description: Per hit: subkind, name, status and links.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_get
tools.description: Full bodies of Clay records by id, up to 25 ids in ONE call (an id ending in * expands to that prefix). Aliases work: web-pmm, section:FeaturesSection, --clay-web-type-family. Each record has a links line (import path, Storybook, Figma, CDN).

ids.description: One id or up to 25. An id ending in * expands to that prefix.

detail.description: Add the full registry record: columns, aliases, links, relations (50 per direction, with counts), render metadata; recipes and pages add pageRecipe.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_list
tools.description: Without `kind`: the record kinds and subkinds with counts. With `kind` (a kind or a subkind, e.g. section, token, logo, rule): its records as `id — summary`, paged.

kind.description: A kind or subkind. Omit to list the kinds.

scope.description: Only this scope: web, email, ds, shared.

status.description: Only this status, e.g. active, deprecated.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_related
tools.description: Typed edges of a record, out and in (variant-of, uses-token, uses-component, has-item, composes, …), grouped by type.

id.description: The record. Accepts a record id (section.FeaturesSection), an entity id (section:FeaturesSection), a skill alias (web-pmm), a handbook id or a CSS variable (--clay-web-type-family).

type.description: Only these relation types, e.g. uses-token, variant-of, has-item.

kind.description: Only edges whose other end has one of these kinds or subkinds.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_asset_url
tools.description: The CDN URL of a logo, icon, badge, agent image or shape (`id → url`). A logo family resolves to the file in `variant` (default: the default file). Use `ids` for many.

id.description: One asset: a record id (asset.logo.customer.adevinta, asset.icon.calendar) or an alias.

variant.description: A logo variant (white, black, default, …); an unmatched variant gives no url rather than another colour.

detail.description: For a logo family: every variant with its url.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_render
tools.description: What a section, layout or component renders to: the stored render rows (variant, theme, screenshots, mirror, version). `html: true` adds the HTML (capped at 60 kB). Renders arrive with registry Phase 3; until a record has one this says so.

id.description: The record. Accepts a record id (section.FeaturesSection), an entity id (section:FeaturesSection), a skill alias (web-pmm), a handbook id or a CSS variable (--clay-web-type-family).

variant.description: Only this variant (e.g. a layout name).

html.description: Include the render HTML (capped at 60 kB; beyond that the mirror url is given).

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_section
tools.description: Sections and layouts: props, item shapes with their copy limits, layouts with item ranges and what each drops, gotchas. Several at once in ONE call: names ["A","B"] with layouts ["x",""] paired by position (an unknown name is reported, the rest still answer). No name lists every section with its layouts.

name.description: e.g. FeaturesSection. Omit (and names) to list every section.

layout.description: e.g. tab-cards-carousel. Several layouts may be comma-separated.

layouts.description: Layouts paired with `names` by position (an empty string = none for that section).

detail.description: Add what the section can hold: item types, nested components, media slots.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_route
tools.description: What do I need for this stage? The ordered, minimal Clay knowledge for one skill × mode × stage (procedure bodies, the policies that decide collisions, brief → layout candidates, ranked gotchas), inlined within a token budget. Call it at the start of every page-build stage.

skill.description: Skill running the stage, e.g. web-compose, web-pmm, web-assets, web-qa, email-compose (email skills route over the email scope). Aliases work.

mode.description: web-compose mode: A = page brief, B = PMM brief (structure and copy already decided).

briefPath.description: Repo mode only: a brief file inside the repo.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_rules
tools.description: The Hard Rules and the Critical/Major policies with enforcement that apply to a stage (and mode); scope "email" lists the email rules instead.

mode.description: web-compose mode: A = page brief, B = PMM brief (structure and copy already decided).

scope.description: `email` lists the email rules; web or omitted lists the web ones.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_check_copy
tools.description: Copy strings checked against the section limits (chars, words, sentences; hard limits are Critical). Pass a PageSpec as `spec`. Repo mode also takes a page file (`page`) or TSX text (`source`).

spec.description: A PageSpec object (or its JSON text).

page.description: Repo mode only: a page name (apps/pages/src/pages/<Page>.tsx) or a .tsx path inside the repo.

source.description: Repo mode only: TSX source text of a page.

all.description: List every checked field, not only the ones outside a limit.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_validate_page
tools.description: Check a PageSpec before rendering it: the schema, unknown section types (with the nearest names), each section's props, the layout-to-content coupling, what the renderer would normalize, and Hard Rule C6 (no two muted sections back to back). Every finding has a JSON path and a rule id.

spec.description: The PageSpec: { brand?, nav?, sections: [{ type, props }] } as an object or JSON text.

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

tools.name: clay_components_using_token
tools.description: Which components and layouts use a design token: `id — summary`. Takes a token id, an alias or a CSS variable (--clay-web-type-family, var(--clay-web-type-family)).

token.description: A token id (token.clay-web-type-family), alias (token:--clay-web-type-family) or CSS variable (--clay-web-type-family).

json.description: Return the answer as JSON text (same content plus the registry version) instead of Markdown.

instructions: Clay: monday.com's marketing design system, registry 0.16.0 (schema 1.1.1). Read-only. Pages compose sections and components exported by @clay-design-system/react (never hand-coded sections); tokens are CSS custom properties, numeric ones unitless: calc(var(--clay-size-16) * 1px). Page build: clay_route per stage; clay_section for props, item shapes, copy limits and layouts; clay_rules for the Hard Rules; clay_search, then clay_get for anything else. Batch: clay_section takes names[] + layouts[], clay_get up to 25 ids, clay_search each[], clay_asset_url ids[]. Before rendering a PageSpec: clay_validate_page, then clay_check_copy. Ids accept aliases (web-pmm, section:FeaturesSection, --clay-*). json:true returns JSON.
